text:
maya: Quick async check — where are we on v2 /embeddings deprec schedule? embedding shape changed in beta; we need an SDK patch before canary. owners: alex/runtime, pat/sdk, jordan/infra. Can we freeze canary tomorrow EOD PT?
alex: Runtime: canary image built, perf looks good. KV cache change handled. Need SDK to support `io=embedding-text` param. ETA today noon PT.
pat: Working on SDK PR #482 — adding compat shim + test vectors. Running CI now. If green I can cut 0.18.1 canary by 4pm PT.
sam: FYI product asked for a grace-period banner + email for users hitting old endpoint. Someone add checkbox to rollout playbook? :thinking_face: 
jordan: Infra: rollout window approved. Canary will be us-west-2 only. I'll watch autoscaler for the first 10m.
maya: @pat ping on tests. Also confirm the old endpoint behaviour: we agreed either redirect (301) or compat shim (200 legacy shape). Which one for canary?
pat: Shim approach: return 200 with legacy shape when `compat=true`, otherwise 422. For canary we'll default to `compat=true` so existing clients keep working. PR: https://git.internal/pat/sdk/pull/482 :thumbsup: 
ci-bot: ci/pat/sdk#482 — unit + integration tests passed, flake fixed.
alex: Runtime note: when `compat=true` we skip kv-prefetch optimization -> ~5% token cost bump. acceptable for canary.
maya: OK locking timeline: cut SDK canary 16:00 PT, runtime canary 17:00 PT, monitor 60m. If stable start GA rollout tomorrow 10:00 PT. I'll update owners doc and add playbook checkbox.
sam: I'll draft email + console blurb and post to #marketing in ~30m.
pat: cutting SDK canary now (cutting tag: sdk-0.18.1-canary).
maya: thanks everyone — please add short postmortem notes in the thread after rollout complete.
